newsitem.title: USA: AccuMed International sets U.S. fungal test trial.
newsitem.headline: AccuMed International sets U.S. fungal test trial.

text.p: AccuMed International Inc said it would begin U.S. clinical trials of its fungal susceptibility test, Sensititre YeastOne, by the end of 1996.
AccuMed introduced the test on Wednesday for use by clinical laboratories in Europe.
AccuMed, a laboratory diagnostic company, said the test will help clinical laboratories in measuring the susceptibility of fungal agents to different types and concentrations of antibiotics.
The test could also help reduce a laboratory's operating costs, AccuMed said. Final results can be obtained in about half the time of the traditional 48 to 72 hours.
